threads.title: When will Aus win another singles Grand Slam tournament?
threads.body: It dosen't look like any time soon unfortunately. Newk says its a bit to do with "rot" in our training systems. Barring a huge investment in a Hopmanlike factory or a freakish individual player coming along. I don't see it happening for decades sadly. Maybe things are more globally competitive than in the past and we spend more developing talent in other sports eg..Rugby League, AFL, swimming, Cricket, etc..you name it.
